name: Stormpike's Deciphering
summary: In Ironforge, Loremaster Dibbs sends you to Prospector Stormpike with an ensorcelled parchment.

sections.title: A Master of Decryption
sections.body: After The Ensorcelled Parchment, Dibbs sends you to Ironforge with the parchment. Prospector Stormpike is studying at the Prospector headquarters. Tell him Dibbs sent you; Dibbs has been bringing Stormpike plenty of business lately.

sections.title: A Matter of Time
sections.body:
Prospector Stormpike finds a fine, intricate spell woven over the parchment. He says he can untangle it, but the work will take time, and his time is valuable. He offers to buy the parchment from you.

Once you agree, Stormpike says he believes no other scholar can translate it. If its contents prove interesting, he promises to send for you.

faq.q: Who sends you to Prospector Stormpike?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs sends you to Prospector Stormpike, whom he calls a master of decryption and deciphering.

faq.q: Where can Prospector Stormpike be found?
faq.answer: Prospector Stormpike is studying at the Prospector headquarters in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is the parchment difficult to read?
faq.answer: A spell obscures the writing, leaving only the name Nagaz readable at the top.
The Ensorcelled Parchment comes before this step and brings the enchanted parchment to Dibbs.
